terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.metaDescription: The terms you agree to when you buy from Haven — orders, prices, delivery, returns and liability.
terms.summary: What you agree to when you buy from us: how orders work, what things cost, how delivery and returns run, and what we are and are not responsible for.

about.heading: Who these terms are with
about.body:
These terms cover everything you buy from {siteName} through this website. They are an agreement between you and {siteName}, {address}. You can reach us at {email} or {phone}.

By placing an order or creating an account you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, please do not order — nothing here is meant to be a surprise, and we would rather answer a question first.

account.heading: Your account
account.body:
You need an account to order, so that your bag, saved pieces and order history follow you between devices. You must give an email address you can actually read — we confirm it before the account becomes usable, and we send order updates there.

Keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account. If you think somebody else has your password, change it, and turn on two-step sign-in from your account settings so a password alone is not enough to get in.

orders.heading: Orders and acceptance
orders.body:
Adding something to your bag is not an order, and placing an order is not yet a contract. Your order is an offer to buy. The contract begins when we email you to confirm the order has been accepted.

We may decline an order if:

  • the piece is out of stock, or the stock count was wrong;
  • the price or description was listed in error;
  • we cannot take payment, or cannot deliver to the address given;
  • we suspect the order is fraudulent.

If we decline after taking payment, you get a full refund by the same method you paid, and we will tell you why.

prices.heading: Prices and payment
prices.body:
Prices are shown in US dollars and include tax where it applies. Delivery is added at checkout and shown before you place the order, so the total you confirm is the total you pay.

Prices can change, but never on an order already accepted. If a piece was listed at an obviously wrong price, we will contact you before doing anything rather than simply cancelling.

This site is a portfolio project and is not connected to a payment provider. No card details are collected, transmitted or stored, and no money is taken. Do not enter real card numbers anywhere on this site.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.body:
Standard delivery is free on orders over $250 and takes three to five working days. Express delivery is next-day where the courier serves it. Furniture is delivered by a two-person team on a date arranged with you, usually within two to four weeks.

Delivery estimates are estimates. Risk passes to you when the order is delivered to the address you gave, or to somebody at that address who accepts it.

returns.heading: Returns and cancellation
returns.body:
You can return anything within 30 days of delivery, in its original condition, and we will refund the full amount including the original delivery cost. We arrange collection.

Made-to-order and personalised pieces cannot be returned unless they are faulty, and we say so clearly on those product pages before you order.

Nothing here affects your legal rights in respect of goods that are faulty, not as described, or not fit for purpose.

reviews.heading: Reviews you write
reviews.body:
You can review a piece you have an account for, once per piece. Reviews are published under the name on your account and are visible to everybody.

Write what you actually think. We remove reviews that are abusive, contain personal information about somebody else, are advertising, or are plainly not about the piece. We do not remove a review for being negative.

liability.heading: Our liability
liability.body:
We are responsible for loss you suffer that is a foreseeable result of us breaking these terms or failing to use reasonable care. We are not responsible for loss that was not foreseeable, or for business losses.

We do not limit our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else the law does not allow us to limit.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body:
We may update these terms. The version that applies to your order is the one published when you placed it, and the date at the top of this page tells you which that is.

Questions about any of this are welcome at {email}. See also our privacy policy, which covers what we do with your data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: What Haven collects, why, how long it is kept, who it is shared with, and the rights you have over it.
privacy.summary: What we collect, why we collect it, who else sees it, how long we keep it, and what you can ask us to do with it.

who.heading: Who is responsible for your data
who.body:
{siteName}, {address}, decides what happens to the personal data described here. If you want to ask about any of it, write to {email}.

This policy covers this website and the emails we send you. It does not cover other sites we link to, which have policies of their own.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.body:
Only what the shop needs to work:

  • Your account — name, email address, and a hashed password. We never store your password itself, only a bcrypt hash of it, which cannot be turned back into the password.
  • Your bag and saved list — which pieces, how many, in which size and colour. These live on your account so they follow you between devices.
  • Orders — what you ordered, what it cost, and the delivery address you gave. An order keeps its own copy of that address, so editing your address book later does not rewrite the history of a parcel already sent.
  • Addresses — any you choose to save, so you do not retype them.
  • Reviews — the rating and words you write, published under your name.

If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google. We do not receive your Google password.

payment.heading: Payment information
payment.body:
We collect no payment information at all. This site is a portfolio project with no payment provider connected. The card fields at checkout are not sent anywhere, not stored, and not processed. No money is taken.

Please do not enter real card details on this site.

why.heading: Why we use it
why.body:
• To create and run your account, and to sign you in.
  • To take, deliver and confirm your orders.
  • To send you the emails the shop has to send: confirming your address, resetting a password, a two-step sign-in code, and order confirmations.
  • To publish the reviews you choose to write.
  • To keep the shop secure and to investigate misuse.

We do not sell your data. We do not share it with advertisers. We do not build a profile of you for advertising.

sharing.heading: Who else sees it
sharing.body:
Only the services needed to run the shop:

  • Resend — delivers our email. It sees the address the message goes to and the contents of that message.
  • MongoDB Atlas — stores the database.
  • Google — only if you choose to sign in with Google.

Staff with an admin or moderator role can see accounts and reviews in order to run the shop. Admins can also edit and remove them. That access is limited to what each role needs and is checked on every request, not just hidden in the interface.

We will also disclose data where the law requires it.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body:
We use two cookies. hv holds your signed-in session and is set only when you sign in. It is httpOnly, meaning no JavaScript on the page can read it, which is what stops a cross-site scripting bug from stealing your session. NEXT_LOCALE remembers whether you are reading the site in English or Georgian, so the right language is rendered on the server before the page reaches you.

There are no analytics cookies, no advertising cookies and no third-party trackers, which is why this site has no cookie banner — there is nothing to ask you to consent to.

Your theme choice (light or dark) is kept in your browser’s local storage, not in a cookie, and never leaves your device.

keeping.heading: How long we keep it
keeping.body:
• Your account — until you ask us to delete it.
  • Orders — kept after account deletion where we have to for tax and accounting, with the account details removed.
  • Sign-in codes and reset links — minutes. Two-step codes expire after ten minutes, password reset links after ten, email confirmation links after 24 hours. Only hashes of these are stored, and they are deleted once used.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body:
You can ask us to:

  • show you a copy of what we hold about you;
  • correct anything that is wrong — much of it you can edit yourself in your account;
  • delete your account and the data attached to it;
  • stop using your data for a particular purpose;
  • send your data to you, or to somebody else, in a portable format.

Write to {email} and we will answer within one month. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

security.heading: Security
security.body:
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Sessions are httpOnly cookies. One-time links and two-step codes are stored only as hashes, so a copy of the database would not hand anybody a working link or code. Staff access is checked by role on the server on every request.

No system is perfectly secure. Turning on two-step sign-in in your account settings is the single most useful thing you can do to protect your account.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body:
If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page changes with it. If a change matters to you — a new purpose, a new recipient — we will tell you by email rather than quietly editing the page.

See also our terms of sale, which cover buying rather than data.
